research_result.description: Coda is a collaborative document and workspace platform providing a RESTful API and an official hosted MCP server to programmatically manage docs, pages, tables, rows, formulas, and controls.
research_result.credential_requirements: Developers can generate an API key or API token directly in their Coda account settings page (coda.io/account) free of charge. OAuth 2.0 is also available for authenticating integrations such as remote MCP clients.

evidence.claim: Coda provides a public RESTful API available to all users free of charge in both free and paid workspaces.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: We make the Coda API available to all of our users free of charge, in both free and paid workspaces.

evidence.claim: Coda supports Bearer token authentication for API requests.
Coda supports OAuth 2 authentication for client integrations.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: When connecting the Coda MCP via OAuth 2 (as with ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor) the auth scope will automatically be set to read and write.

evidence.claim: Coda allows users to generate API keys in account settings to connect with the API.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Generate an API Key for your Coda account

evidence.claim: Coda provides an official hosted MCP server at coda.io/apis/mcp.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Yes — Coda has an official MCP server. It’s a hosted, remote server at coda.io/apis/mcp that lets any MCP-compatible AI tool read and write your Coda docs, pages, tables, and rows.
